fundamentals_narrative: The growth numbers genuinely justify the curator's enthusiasm - this is exceptional, broad-based, accelerating growth (90% TTM profit growth). But Screener flags real cash-flow quality concerns beneath that growth: negative free cash flow, a working-capital cycle that has stretched to 201 days, and gradual promoter dilution (-5 percentage points over 3 years) - a combination worth reconciling with the growth story before assuming it's fully clean. Valuation (P/E 57.6x, P/B 9.1x) already prices in a lot of continued execution.
